hook: HYDRAA fences *9 acres* of lake land after residents complain
hook_b: HYDRAA fences *9 acres* of lake land after residents complain
tldr: HYDRAA protected two lakes in Medchal-Malkajgiri district on Saturday after residents complained of fresh encroachment attempts.

beats.what: The lakes are the 3.11-acre Gollavani Kunta at Dummarapochampally (Dundigal mandal) and the 27-acre Chintala Cheruvu in Qutbullapur mandal.
beats.why: Residents reported soil dumping, renewed illegal construction and temporary sheds on lake land.
beats.care: Signboards now mark the land as lake property and warn that trespassers will be prosecuted.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: After an inspection, HYDRAA teams fenced nine acres and put up warning boards.

cards.q: Is there a lake near you facing encroachment?

qs: How much of the two lakes' 30 acres remains unfenced?
What happens to the sheds already built on lake land?

facts.t: The two lakes together cover over *30 acres* (3.11 + 27).

viz.verdict: Two lakes of very different size, both reported encroached

watch: Whether HYDRAA follows the fencing with action on the illegal structures residents named.

fact: HYDRAA fences *nine acres* of lake land in Qutbullapur and Dundigal after complaints
twist: Chintala Cheruvu alone covers *27 acres*, across Gajularamaram and Devender Nagar.
